shots.title: Scope workflow-step-gate to session/current sprint and fail open on ambiguous executions (#531)
shots.notes: Replaced active[0] workflow selection with deterministic scoping: match the hook session first, then branch/current sprint, then preserve single-active-execution behavior, and fail open with context when multiple executions cannot be disambiguated.

shots.title: Bump package and bundled plugin manifest to 1.58.3 for the workflow gate fix
shots.notes: Ran scripts/version-bump.mjs 1.58.3 so package.json and templates/codex/plugins/slope/.codex-plugin/plugin.json moved together, then verified the built CLI reports @slope-dev/slope v1.58.3.

conditions.description: Issue #531 appeared after the patch-release loop because long-lived workflow executions from older sprints could still coexist with the active sprint execution.

training.description: Workflow guards that inspect durable running executions must scope by session or sprint before applying blocking policy.
training.outcome: workflow-step-gate now blocks only a relevant non-agent_work execution and allows edits when multiple running executions are ambiguous.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm test`, and `corepack pnpm build` passed; full suite reported 232 test files passed, 1 skipped, 3645 tests passed, and 25 skipped.
`node dist/cli/index.js roadmap validate`, `map --check`, `docs generate`, and `docs check` passed after the 1.58.3 build.
`node dist/cli/index.js version` reports @slope-dev/slope v1.58.3; after merge, create GitHub Release `v1.58.3` and verify npm latest updates through the GitHub Release workflow.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A precise follow-up: the bug was small, but it sat right on SLOPE's own ability to enforce discipline without blocking the wrong work.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Whenever a guard reads a global running-execution list, add a multi-execution regression before trusting ordering.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The existing resync logic already handled some stale branch cases, but active sprint-state and session scoping still needed to be explicit.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The release loop can now continue without unrelated workflow history turning into a global edit lock.

bunker_locations: Workflow guards that inspect running executions must not choose active[0] when multiple sessions or sprints can be running.
yardage_book_updates: src/cli/guards/workflow-step-gate.ts now selects a running workflow execution by session, branch/current sprint, or single-active fallback.
tests/cli/guards/workflow-step-gate.test.ts covers current-sprint selection, session selection, and ambiguous multi-execution fail-open behavior.
course_management_notes: GitHub issue #531 is closed by the S146.3 PR.
After merge, create GitHub Release `v1.58.3` and verify npm latest updates.
